title: Integrated multi-stream valorization of kitchen food waste through enzymatic hydrolysis and selective fermentation
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00778J, Paper

Shubhangi Arvelli, Deokyeol Jeong, Mairui Zhang, Linjing Jia, Haixin Peng, Ji Qi, Nilofar Arabi, Seyedamirreza Babaei, Eun Joong Oh, Jikai Zhao
This study propose a multistream biorefinery converting food waste into fats, fermentable glucose, and protein rich residue, which further valorized into biodiesel, ethanol, 3-hydroxyproponic acid, and animal feed, supporting a circular economy.
